load_overlap_data: load a pairwise overlap matrix numpy file from a scene folder covisibility directory
preprocess_to_adjacency_list: convert a dense overlap matrix into an adjacency list dictionary with neighbor indices
process_single_scene: process a single scene overlap matrix by normalizing, thresholding, and converting to adjacency list
aggregate_scenes: aggregate pairwise overlap matrices across multiple scenes into a single npz metadata file
DatasetAggregator_class: aggregate dataset scenes into train val and test splits with covisibility adjacency metadata
RandomSplitAggregator_class: aggregate dataset scenes into train and val splits using random scene selection by ratio
